lead.headline: Likely starts on a Friday DNP; the call holds until 13:55
lead.deck: Nothing new overnight. If he is inactive, add Okonkwo for Diggs. Tuten to FLEX before noon is still free insurance.
lead.body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely, your only tight end, did not practise Friday with a groin injury, and nothing newer had appeared by 07:00 Sunday. The Giants gave him no status and Harbaugh called it 'a minor thing', so he starts. This is provisional until Jacksonville–New York inactives at 13:55 CDMX. Chem's flex takes no tight end. If he is out, add Chig Okonkwo (free agent, full practice all week, Monday night) and drop Stefon Diggs. Tuten is cleared. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. The one free improvement is Tuten to FLEX and Gordon to RB before noon.

players.caption: Likely: DNP Friday (groin), no update by Sunday
Tuten: cleared, still in an RB slot

doFirst.headline: Two checks before kickoff
doFirst.deck: Swap Gordon and Tuten before 12:00. At 13:55, check Likely.
doFirst.note: Both are insurance. Neither changes the projection lineup, which you set on Friday. Lineup calls resting on inactives are provisional until each game's inactives.
doFirst.empty: No card this morning: the lineup is already the projection lineup. The two insurance checks are in the deck above.

roster.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup (137.1). Tuten would be safer in FLEX, and Likely has a Monday-night fallback.
